rules.title: Hostel Entry & Exit Timings
rules.description: Hostel main gates open at 6:00 AM and close at 9:30 PM (Sunday-Thursday) and 10:00 PM (Friday-Saturday). All residents must enter the hostel premises before curfew time.

rules.title: Night Roll-Call & Attendance
rules.description: Mandatory biometric attendance and warden roll-call takes place daily at 9:45 PM in the floor common lobbies. Unauthorized absence attracts a fine of ₹500 and parent notification.

rules.title: Visitor Policy & Hours
rules.description: Visitors and parents are allowed only in the Visitor Lounge on the Ground Floor between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM. No opposite-gender visitors or external guests are permitted in student living corridors under any circumstances.

rules.title: Leave Application & Out-Pass
rules.description: For overnight leave or weekend outstation travel, students must submit a digital leave application on the hostel portal at least 24 hours prior. Gate pass is granted after automated/manual parent approval via registered mobile number.

rules.title: ID Card Mandatory
rules.description: Every student must carry their biometric RFID Hostel ID Card. Entry through turnstiles requires physical scanning. Lost ID must be immediately reported to the Warden office for deactivation and reissue (₹200 fee).

rules.title: Cleanliness & Zero-Tolerance Items
rules.description: Possession or consumption of alcohol, tobacco, narcotics, or prohibited hazardous items is strictly forbidden and results in immediate expulsion. Room inspections are conducted randomly.

rules.title: Electrical Appliances Restriction
rules.description: High-power electrical appliances such as immersion rods, electric heaters, induction stoves, and hotplates are strictly prohibited due to fire safety regulations. Laptops, mobile chargers, and electric kettles (up to 500W) are permitted.

rules.title: Silence & Study Hours
rules.description: Quiet hours must be maintained between 11:00 PM and 6:00 AM to facilitate study and sleep. Loud music, shouting, or noisy group gatherings in corridors are strictly prohibited.
